scope: Complete CPU ModelAsset resource graph, not EditorAsset/App/import provenance

ModelAsset.primitives: native primitive files with exact metadata plus shared skin-set references
ModelAsset.animations: ordered exact outer clip Arc identities and internal cache ownership
ModelAsset.mesh_joint: exact imported local joint index with native bounds admission

MorphImportData.defaults: native PropertySet exact source words/name aliases
MorphImportData.sources: actual ordered outer AnimationClip Arc references
MorphImportData.skeleton: optional native rig reference with original aliases
MorphImportData.clips: native property clip source data and sharing

MorphBinding.name: optional name reference in shared cross-participant pool
MorphBinding.geometry: complete native MorphGeometry archive plus original skin-stream/cache sharing
MorphBinding.defaults: exact finite f32 words in source target order

MorphGeometry.source: complete primitive record; static Vec streams remain owned; skin Arc streams join global skin set
MorphGeometry.targets: native ordered optional source-local position/normal arrays via participant

cross_participant_names.capture: collect all actual native and metadata names; intern by pointer identity only
cross_participant_names.prepare: skeletal participant supplies ordered restored names; property participant validates and reuses them
cross_participant_names.compatibility: plain v1 participants omit the optional binding field and retain former wire shape
